verdict.rationale: Undermind documents a public MCP server (mcp.undermind.ai) with clear tool definitions for search, PDF Q&A, and workspace notes, which does let an AI agent drive the product programmatically (undermind-docs-3,4,5,13,14,15,19). However, a general documented REST/OpenAPI-style public API is only vaguely alluded to ('Programmatic queries via API' under Enterprise) and probes for llms.txt, docs.md, and openapi/swagger specs all return 404s, indicating no broadly published API reference. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/Swagger spec or REST API docs, and confirmation that the enterprise API is self-serve rather than sales-gated.
